scope: Independent read-only review of one proposed feature workflow and its existing source/reference contracts. No execution or mutation.

findings.conclusion: The only trigger is push to integration/lumo-feature-connections-20261114. The job repeats the exact repository/event/ref guard, checks out github.sha and disables persisted credentials. contents:read is the only granted permission. There is no APK, release, dispatch or pull_request job in the proposed file. Referenced Android-debug/unified/release push allowlists do not include this branch; no global claim about all other repository workflows is made.

The before step creates a fresh evidence directory under RUNNER_TEMP. It records HEAD, tree, complete staged-entry bytes and tracked-only status, then hashes every tracked regular file or symlink against its index blob and executable mode. A dirty index/working tree, unknown type/stage or mismatched expected push head fails. The always after step compares head/tree/staged-index representation and full file inventory and repeats clean status. This is semantic staged-index content, not a claim about raw .git/index container bytes.

Flutter3.44.9, external Python venv/Pillow12.3.0 and enforce-lockfile match the existing source contract. Original two images and four font files require six exact Git blobs; images also undergo PNG structural verification. This is asset identity verification, not a new visual render or a claim of independently decoded production captures. pubspec files belong to the complete tracked inventory.

Exactly the three specified test files run once with no-pub, machine output, concurrency2 and60s per test, within20 minutes. stdout/stderr remain separate unfiltered originals and the actual exit is stored and propagated. The poststep runs even after a failed executed Flutter step. The existing summarize function requires zero failed/skipped cases, successful done event and exit0; the additional check requires exactly22 non-hidden successes and zero error events. Missing output/result falls closed. Non-JSON stdout line numbers are recorded, not mistaken for successful cases.

The always after-source step remains required after successful initial binding, even when tests fail. Upload always preserves the evidence outside the checkout, includes hidden files and rejects a missing evidence directory. Setup failures preserve both streams and an actual return code. A failure is never converted to PASS by later report or upload steps.

This source review finds no concrete blocker. It neither executes nor certifies the22 widget cases, package resolution, genuine camera/native behavior or CI success. Existing functional source/pins/receipts/workflows were not edited. The author-executed single Actionlint result is separately original-bound and not rerun by this reviewer.
